trust_decision.summary: Decided where the keadm upgrade command is built: the NodeUpgradeJob version and image strings are checked against a regexp (new pkg/util/validation.ValidateVersion/ValidateImageRepo) in the cloud admission webhook and in the edge agent's Check and Upgrade actions, and the command is started as an argv list (exec.Command("keadm", args...)) so neither field can be concatenated into a bash -c string.

landing_point.why: The only place where NodeUpgradeJob spec strings are concatenated into a shell command line ('keadm upgrade edge --force --toVersion '+spec.Version, ' --image '+spec.Image, built with strings.Builder and handed to execs.NewCommand, which is exec.Command("bash","-c",...)); this is what an engineer reading 'Command Injection in NodeUpgradeJob - RCE on edge nodes via v1alpha2 API' searches for first.

fix_sites.entry_point: validating admission webhook HTTP POST /nodeupgradejobs (cloud admission controller; rule registered for operations.kubeedge.io/v1alpha1 at cloud/pkg/admissioncontroller/admission.go:277-304, handler at cloud/pkg/admissioncontroller/admission.go:108)

edgecore TaskManager receives a NodeUpgradeJob node-job message and runs the Check action (edge/pkg/taskmanager/taskmanager.go:103-107 -> edge/pkg/taskmanager/task_runner.go:33-44 -> nodeUpgradeJobActionHandler.checkItems)

same runner's Upgrade action, reached from the action flow and directly from the edge metaserver route 'create .../confirm-upgrade' (edge/pkg/metamanager/metaserver/server.go:230-231 -> edge/pkg/metamanager/metaserver/handlerfactory/extend_confirm_upgrade.go:37-101, which starts the flow at BackUp and skips Check)

edgecore TaskManager dispatch of a v1alpha1 NodeUpgradeJob task message (edge/pkg/taskmanager/taskmanager.go:105-106 -> edge/pkg/taskmanager/v1alpha1/task_runner.go:35-49 -> taskexecutor upgrade -> keadmUpgrade); also the v1alpha1 branch of the confirm-upgrade handler (extend_confirm_upgrade.go:104-121)
no public entry point of its own; shared helper package consumed by the three sites above

O3_reason_to_dismiss: v1alpha1 is marked deprecated and 'will be removed in v1.23' (edge/pkg/metamanager/dao/dbclient/upgrade_v2.go:42,152) and the report names the v1alpha2 API, so the legacy executor looks out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate upgrade jobs carry an image reference that may already have a ':tag' or '@sha256:...' suffix (documented as being overwritten by Version) or a registry with a port, and a version string has been accepted without the leading 'v' (the pinned test builds 'keadm upgrade edge --force --toVersion 1.21.0'). An over-broad fix that strips or rejects ':'/'@' in the image, or that requires a 'v'-prefixed strict semver, breaks those documented, previously-working inputs.

O6_input_shapes: version without leading v, uppercase V, or v1.0 (rejected)
version carrying ';', '$()', backticks or a newline (rejected)
image repo/name and multi-segment repo path (accepted)
image with registry host and ':5000' port (accepted)
image carrying ';', '$()', backticks or a newline (rejected)

O7_producer.where: edge/pkg/metamanager/dao/dbclient/upgrade_v2.go:79-119 - the NodeUpgradeJobSpec is JSON-marshalled into the meta_v2 sqlite row in preRun (edge/pkg/taskmanager/actions/nodeupgradejob.go:92-95) and unmarshalled back on the confirm and rollback paths (edge/pkg/metamanager/metaserver/handlerfactory/extend_confirm_upgrade.go:43-44, edge/pkg/taskmanager/hub_connected_hooker.go:49-50); the CRD schema that first admits the value also constrains nothing (build/crds/operations/operations_v1alpha2_nodeupgradejob.yaml:387 'version: type: string')

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ConfigUpdateJob.updateConfig builds 'keadm config-update --set <key>=<value>,...' from ConfigUpdateJobSpec.UpdateFields into a shell string via execs.NewCommand (bash -c); the published fix left it untouched
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the ConfigUpdateJob path, not NodeUpgradeJob: the report and its fix name only the NodeUpgradeJob Version/Image fields, so a solver can call this neighbouring feature out of scope.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (edge/pkg/taskmanager/actions), one file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: v1alpha1 NodeUpgradeJob rollback still formats 'keadm rollback edge --name <upgradeID> --history <version>' and runs it with exec.Command("bash","-c",...); the fix converted only the upgrade command in the sibling file
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the rollback action rather than upgrade, and its fields are the job name (DNS-1123, no metacharacters allowed) and the node's own local version, so it looks non-injectable and legacy.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package as the fixed legacy executor, adjacent file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second validating-webhook rule for operations.kubeedge.io/v1alpha2 nodeupgradejobs reusing validateNodeUpgradeJob's checks
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The shipped CRD already serves v1alpha1 and v1alpha2, with v1alpha2 as storage (build/crds/operations/operations_v1alpha2_nodeupgradejob.yaml:17,233,499), but the webhook rule lists only v1alpha1, so cloning that block for the storage version is a one-line change a maintainer would plausibly write.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Validate spec.Version/Image inside Upgrade.Save, i.e. at the persistence boundary, instead of only in the two handlers
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every v1alpha2 upgrade passes through preRun's Save and the confirm route reloads exactly this row, so a maintainer hardening the save/reload path would naturally put the check here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A buildConfigUpdateCommandArgs argv builder mirroring buildNodeUpgradeJobCommandArgs, replacing the execs.NewCommand shell string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same package just gained buildNodeUpgradeJobCommandArgs; copying that pattern for the neighbouring ConfigUpdateJob command is the obvious next commit.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78): API-object strings concatenated into a command line executed through bash -c

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.23.12 (go.mod:3); builds from the vendored dependency tree (vendor/); make-based build
services: none for the affected unit tests (edge taskmanager, admission controller, pkg/util/validation)
a CRI runtime endpoint (containerd/docker) and an image registry only for a real end-to-end upgrade
O10_build.project_tests: cloud/pkg/admissioncontroller/admit_nodeupgradejob_test.go; edge/pkg/taskmanager/actions/nodeupgradejob_test.go (pinned version asserts the vulnerable string 'bash -c keadm upgrade edge --force --toVersion 1.21.0 >> /tmp/keadm.log 2>&1' at :280 and an image case at :297); edge/pkg/metamanager/metaserver/handlerfactory/extend_confirm_upgrade_test.go; edge/pkg/taskmanager/hub_connected_hooker_test.go; pkg/nodetask/actionflow/action_flow_test.go; pkg/util/validation/validation_test.go; the v1alpha1 taskexecutor package has no test at the pinned commit (the fix adds node_upgrade_test.go)
